tools.name: search_podcast
tools.description:
Full-text search over Built for MENA episode transcripts. Returns up to `limit` (max 10)
passages of about 120 words, each with episode number, title, guest, timestamp (mm:ss in the
published audio), episode link and speaker. Speaker is named only when the voice match is certain;
otherwise it is ""

tools.name: list_episodes
tools.description:
Every published Built for MENA episode (trailer excluded), newest first, with number, title,
guest, company, release date, length, link and whether its transcript is searchable yet.

tools.name: get_episode
tools.description:
One Built for MENA episode by number (e.g. "10") or "special" for The Story So Far: title, guest,
company, date, length, link, and up to 5 key passages (about 120 words each) in order. Never the full
transcript: use search_podcast to find specific quotes.

tools.name: explain_pdooh
tools.description:
Plain-English explanations of programmatic digital out of home (pDOOH) from Dom Kozak's released
pDOOH 101 and 201 lessons. Returns up to `limit` (max 10) passages with series (101/201), episode,
lesson title, hook, airDate, the relevant lesson text and the lesson URL on domkozak.com.

tools.name: list_lessons
tools.description: Released pDOOH 101 and 201 lessons, in order, with series, episode, title, hook, airDate and URL.
